scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/shared-types && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/error-mapping && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/hanet-client && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/shared-infra
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/api && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/worker && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/hanet-mock && npm run build --workspace=@thanh-giuse/admin
scripts.test: vitest run tests/*.test.ts tests/contract/*.spec.ts tests/registration.spec.ts tests/sync-alias-reconciliation.spec.ts tests/requeue-pending-edge-cases.spec.ts tests/concurrency-duplicate-registration.spec.ts tests/teacher-authorization-bypass.spec.ts tests/frontend-polling.spec.ts && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: find . -name 'dist' -type d -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -exec rm -rf {} + 2>/dev/null; find . -name '*.tsbuildinfo' -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -delete 2>/dev/null; echo 'clean done'
